subject: Throughput elevation & rate-lane realignment for NimbleCart renewal
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimblecart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Throughput elevation & renewal planning — NimbleCart

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the call earlier. As NimbleCart approaches renewal in August, we sketched a plan to align your hosted usage pattern with a smoother rate experience and predictable unit economics. High level:

- Move from your current 1.5M token monthly baseline to a 3.5M monthly committed baseline (tiered).
- Add a burst window (2x baseline) for seasonal spikes during promo weeks with soft-throttle protection.
- Keep the same per-token price up to baseline, stepped discount above baseline.

Can you confirm two quick things for the proposal:
1) Typical monthly 95th percentile token consumption for last 3 months (so we size the baseline);
2) Which month(s) you expect sustained spike traffic (Q3 promo / holiday weeks)?

I'll loop Karthik and Neha on the technical and commercial detail. If this looks reasonable I'll send a short pricing sheet + SOW for signature.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0128

Attachments: none in this message
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimblecart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@nimblecart.com>, procurement@nimblecart.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Throughput elevation & renewal planning — NimbleCart

Awesome, thanks Marissa. Quick answers:

- 95th percentile for last 3 months: ~2.8M tokens/month (we saw a steady climb from 1.9M in March).
- Biggest spike window is Q4 flash sales (we also get ~30% uplift in September during regional promotions).

A few questions:
1) How does the burst window interact with rate-limits? If we hit burst, do you throttle or queue?
2) If we commit to a higher baseline, can we lock a specific quantization/latency SLA for the top-tier model we use (redwood-gen-4-large)?
3) Any changes to invoicing cadence — we prefer monthly invoicing with clear overage lines for finance.

Priya from Ops is copied — she'll own procurement. Procurement will want a short SOW and a line-item pricing file.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Product — NimbleCart
liam.oconnor@nimblecart.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Throughput elevation & renewal planning — NimbleCart (pricing options)

Marissa / team —

I pulled numbers with Aditya and Neha based on the 2.8M 95th percentile Liam cited. Proposed commercial structure (summary):

Option A — Predictable Baseline (recommended)
- Baseline: 3.5M tokens/month committed for 12 months
- Burst window: 7M tokens/month soft window (2x baseline) with auto-fallback to compatible quantized variant if queueing risk > 10%
- Pricing: baseline price $0.0009/token, overage above baseline billed at $0.0011/token after burst allowance
- Invoicing: monthly; credits apply for sustained under-usage at quarter finish

Option B — Conservative Step Plan
- Baseline: 2.5M tokens/month for 12 months
- Burst window: 5M tokens/month with short-term surge credits available on request
- Pricing: baseline $0.0010/token, overage $0.00125/token

Technical notes from Neha: we can lock a latency SLA for redwood-gen-4-large during baseline capacity; quantization fallback is only applied during sustained overload and will be communicated via webhook/console 2 minutes prior. We'll include model pinning in the SOW.

Aditya: finance prefers Option A if NimbleCart signs a 12-month term and accepts a 30% prepay (to secure dedicated burst capacity). If they want monthly payback, the per-token baseline price rises ~8%.

I'll draft a pricing spreadsheet + SOW for Marissa to send to NimbleCart. Any objections?

- Karthik

Attachments: none
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimblecart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, procurement@nimblecart.com
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal & SOW — NimbleCart renewal (Option A recommended)

Hi Liam / Priya —

Following up with the formal offer per our internal pricing review. We recommend Option A to cover your observed 95th percentile and provide headroom for September and Q4. Summary below and attached: Redwood_NimbleCart_Pricing_2028.xlsx (line-item pricing) and SOW_NimbleCart_v2.pdf (term, model pinning, onboarding checklist).

Key points:
- Baseline: 3.5M tokens/month (12-month term)
- Burst window: up to 7M tokens/month (softly enforced; we will provide 48-hour notice if sustained adjustments look necessary)
- Model pinning: redwood-gen-4-large for baseline; automatic fallback to quantized-gen-4 if system-wide overload; webhook notifications for any fallback event
- SLA: 95th percentile p99 latency target of 220ms for baseline; credits defined in SOW for sustained SLA breaches
- Commercial: $0.0009/token on baseline (monthly invoice). 30% term prepay reduces per-token baseline to $0.00085. Overages billed monthly.

Attached docs:
- Redwood_NimbleCart_Pricing_2028.xlsx (Excel)
- SOW_NimbleCart_v2.pdf (PDF)

DocuSign link for signature: https://www.docusign.com/1234-abcd-rc-nimblecart

Next steps:
1) Priya / procurement — review SOW and confirm legal redlines (if any) by Fri 6/16
2) If approved, sign the DocuSign envelope and provide PO number
3) We kick off onboarding with Neha once payment terms are confirmed (ETA: 7 business days after signing)

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the SOW.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Redwood_NimbleCart_Pricing_2028.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
- SOW_NimbleCart_v2.pdf (PDF stub)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimblecart.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <pshah@nimblecart.com>, procurement@nimblecart.com
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal & SOW — NimbleCart renewal (Option A recommended)

Marissa / team —

We reviewed and NimbleCart will proceed with Option A. Procurement will sign via DocuSign today and provide PO/finance details (PO# NX-2028-709). A few operational asks before handoff:

- Please confirm onboarding kickoff date once DocuSign completes (we prefer the week of July 2).
- Can Neha share the onboarding runbook and a checklist of integration artifacts (API keys, webhook endpoints, expected schema)?
- We'd like confirmation that the 30% prepay option can be wired via standard vendor payment terms (net 30) after the DocuSign signature. Aditya / Karthik — can you confirm?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Liam
Head of Product — NimbleCart
